description: This file defines the Reminder_Invitee class, which manages invitee data related to reminders in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for saving, loading, and deleting invitee records, and handles associations with different modules like Users, Contacts, and Leads.

classes.name: Reminder_Invitee
classes.description: A class representing invitees for reminders, with methods to save, load, and delete invitee data, and to retrieve invitee names based on module type.

methods.name: saveRemindersInviteesData
methods.description: Saves multiple invitee records associated with a specific reminder ID.

methods.name: loadRemindersInviteesData
methods.description: Loads invitee data associated with a specific reminder ID.

methods.name: getInviteeName
methods.description: Retrieves the display name of an invitee based on their module and ID.

methods.name: deleteRemindersInviteesMultiple
methods.description: Deletes multiple invitee records for a given reminder ID, excluding specified invitee IDs.
